rule.message:
To be eligible to apply to the major, students must have:
At least 45 credits completed or in progress
A GPA above 2.0 is required. A GPA of 2.5, or higher, is preferred.
Completed one course from five of the six following categories:
Students transferring into the University of Minnesota must have completed one course from four of the six prerequisite categories.
Once admitted to the major, transfer students will be expected to complete any outstanding courses from the six prerequisite categories their first semester. First Year Experience is required of incoming freshmen only; it does not apply to transfer students. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

All students must complete the University's Liberal Education requirements .
Collegiate Requirements:
At least 22 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
